answer:
Four things force the sorted path without `--sort`, all in `runSearch` in `src/main.zig`:

- `--exec` (`src/main.zig:2190`): it needs to know which files matched, and only the ordered path keeps that (`src/main.zig:2186-2189`).
- `--heading` (`src/main.zig:2195`): streaming output would interleave the per-file groups (`src/main.zig:2191-2194`).
- `--pre` (`src/main.zig:2197`): it runs per file, so it needs the ordered path (`src/main.zig:2196`).
- Several explicit file operands, with no directories (`src/main.zig:2362`): they are answered in argument order, like GNU grep (`src/main.zig:2357-2360`).

Also, `--queries-file` batches run every query as `zgrep --json --sort ...` (`src/main.zig:1892`, `src/main.zig:1925`).

Directories keep the streaming path (`src/main.zig:2360-2361`). The unsorted path is taken only when `!opts.sort` (`src/main.zig:2377`).
